svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="draw.io" version="24.4.0" type="device"> <diagram id="stacksaga-orchestrator-atomic-transactions" name="orchestrator-atomic-transactions"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="650" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1180" pageHeight="600" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<!-- Master Title --> <mxCell id="title" value="<b style='font-size:15px;color:#0F172A;'>Saga Orchestrator Service &amp; Atomic Transaction Boundaries</b><br/><span style='font-size:11px;color:#475569;'>Order Service Orchestrator hosting 4 discrete executors executing doProcess() and doRevert() against target microservices</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#E2E8F0;strokeWidth=1.2;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="15" width="1120" height="48" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Big Container: Order Service (Orchestrator) --> <mxCell id="orch_container" value="<b style='font-size:13px;color:#1E293B;'>Order Service Application (Saga Orchestrator)</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=4;fillColor=#F1F5F9;strokeColor=#94A3B8;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=15;spacingTop=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="80" width="570" height="485" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Executor 1: Query --> <mxCell id="box_exec1" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="orch_container"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="40" width="530" height="92" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_exec1" value="<b style='font-size:12px;color:#15803D;'>CheckCustomerEligibilityExecutor</b><br/><span style='font-size:10px;color:#166534;'>QueryExecutor&lt;OrderAggregate&gt;</span>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec1"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="8" width="260" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec1_proc" value="doProcess() ➔" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#16A34A;strokeColor=#15803D;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec1"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="48" width="130" height="32" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec1_rev" value="[ doRevert: Skipped ]" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;strokeDashed=1;fontColor=#94A3B8;fontSize=9.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec1"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="48" width="135" height="32" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="desc_exec1" value="Read-only query: Checks customer status &amp; credit limit" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#64748B;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec1"> <mxGeometry x="300" y="48" width="220" height="32" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Executor 2: Command Order --> <mxCell id="box_exec2" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="orch_container"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="145" width="530" height="98" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_exec2" value="<b style='font-size:12px;color:#1E40AF;'>CreateOrderCommandExecutor</b><br/><span style='font-size:10px;color:#2563EB;'>CommandExecutor&lt;OrderAggregate&gt;</span>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec2"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="8" width="260" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec2_proc" value="doProcess() ➔" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#16A34A;strokeColor=#15803D;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec2"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="48" width="130" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec2_rev" value="⬅ doRevert()" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#DC2626;strokeColor=#B91C1C;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec2"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="48" width="135" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="desc_exec2" value="Persists order (PENDING)<br/>Revert cancels order in DB" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#64748B;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec2"> <mxGeometry x="300" y="48" width="220" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Executor 3: Command Payment --> <mxCell id="box_exec3" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="orch_container"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="255" width="530" height="98" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_exec3" value="<b style='font-size:12px;color:#1E40AF;'>ProcessPaymentCommandExecutor</b><br/><span style='font-size:10px;color:#2563EB;'>CommandExecutor&lt;OrderAggregate&gt;</span>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec3"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="8" width="260" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec3_proc" value="doProcess() ➔" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#16A34A;strokeColor=#15803D;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec3"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="48" width="130" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec3_rev" value="⬅ doRevert()" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#DC2626;strokeColor=#B91C1C;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec3"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="48" width="135" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="desc_exec3" value="Authorizes credit card charge<br/>Revert voids / refunds transaction" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#64748B;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec3"> <mxGeometry x="300" y="48" width="220" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Executor 4: Command Inventory --> <mxCell id="box_exec4" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="orch_container"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="365" width="530" height="98" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_exec4" value="<b style='font-size:12px;color:#1E40AF;'>ReserveStockCommandExecutor</b><br/><span style='font-size:10px;color:#2563EB;'>CommandExecutor&lt;OrderAggregate&gt;</span>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec4"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="8" width="260" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec4_proc" value="doProcess() ➔" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#16A34A;strokeColor=#15803D;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec4"> <mxGeometry x="12" y="48" width="130" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="btn_exec4_rev" value="⬅ doRevert()" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#DC2626;strokeColor=#B91C1C;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10.5;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec4"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="48" width="135" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="desc_exec4" value="Deducts stock in warehouse<br/>Revert restores stock units" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#64748B;" vertex="1" parent="box_exec4"> <mxGeometry x="300" y="48" width="220" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Right Side: 4 Target Microservices --> <mxCell id="target1" value="<b style='color:#1E293B;'>User Service</b><br/><span style='font-size:9.5px;color:#64748B;'>User DB (PostgreSQL)</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;strokeWidth=1.5;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="840" y="125" width="290" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="target2" value="<b style='color:#1E293B;'>Order Service (Local DB)</b><br/><span style='font-size:9.5px;color:#64748B;'>Order DB (PostgreSQL ACID)</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;strokeWidth=1.5;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="840" y="235" width="290" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="target3" value="<b style='color:#1E293B;'>Payment Service / Gateway</b><br/><span style='font-size:9.5px;color:#64748B;'>Stripe / Bank REST API</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;strokeWidth=1.5;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="840" y="345" width="290" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="target4" value="<b style='color:#1E293B;'>Inventory Service</b><br/><span style='font-size:9.5px;color:#64748B;'>Warehouse DB (MySQL)</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;strokeWidth=1.5;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="840" y="455" width="290" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Forward & Revert Connectors --> <!-- 1 -> Target 1 (Forward Only) --> <mxCell id="edge1_fwd" value="doProcess(): GET /users/{id}" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#15803D;" edge="1" parent="1" source="btn_exec1_proc" target="target1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- 2 -> Target 2 (Forward & Revert) --> <mxCell id="edge2_fwd" value="doProcess(): saveOrder()" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#15803D;" edge="1" parent="1" source="btn_exec2_proc" target="target2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"><mxPoint x="710" y="278" /><mxPoint x="710" y="255" /></Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge2_rev" value="doRevert(): cancelOrder()" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#DC2626;strokeWidth=1.8;strokeDashed=1;endArrow=classic;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#DC2626;" edge="1" parent="1" source="btn_exec2_rev" target="target2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"><mxPoint x="730" y="288" /><mxPoint x="730" y="290" /></Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<!-- 3 -> Target 3 (Forward & Revert) --> <mxCell id="edge3_fwd" value="doProcess(): POST /charge" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#15803D;" edge="1" parent="1" source="btn_exec3_proc" target="target3"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"><mxPoint x="710" y="388" /><mxPoint x="710" y="365" /></Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge3_rev" value="doRevert(): POST /refund" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#DC2626;strokeWidth=1.8;strokeDashed=1;endArrow=classic;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#DC2626;" edge="1" parent="1" source="btn_exec3_rev" target="target3"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"><mxPoint x="730" y="398" /><mxPoint x="730" y="400" /></Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<!-- 4 -> Target 4 (Forward & Revert) --> <mxCell id="edge4_fwd" value="doProcess(): POST /reserve" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#15803D;" edge="1" parent="1" source="btn_exec4_proc" target="target4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"><mxPoint x="710" y="498" /><mxPoint x="710" y="475" /></Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge4_rev" value="doRevert(): POST /release" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#DC2626;strokeWidth=1.8;strokeDashed=1;endArrow=classic;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#DC2626;" edge="1" parent="1" source="btn_exec4_rev" target="target4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"><mxPoint x="730" y="508" /><mxPoint x="730" y="510" /></Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
svg.style: background-color: #ffffff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

g.text: Saga Orchestrator Service & Atomic Transaction Boundaries
The Order Service application hosts 4 separate executors encapsulating 1-to-1 atomic transactions with target services
External: Stripe / Core Banking REST API
